doc: The marker and the judgement of 'reached' that every language of the zoo shares (docs/DESIGN-zoo.md, section 3.2). A source returns 'Z<tag>' followed, for each class in 'order', by its segment and the danger of the variant that runs. Both variants of a class have the same length and are made of characters of the class's dangerous set, so a sanitizer (which replaces every character of the set by '_') gives the same text for both; the set of a class holds no character of the danger of another class. Variant 0 and variant 1 run in different processes; a sink that gets different text in the two and has not reached is a carry.

Cmd.reached: the danger is in the text, contiguous and intact, and its first character is outside a quote (single quotes and double quotes are tracked from the start of the text; a backslash outside single quotes escapes the next character)

SQL.reached: the danger is in the text, and its first character (the quote) is not preceded by a backslash or a quote and not followed by a quote (it is not escaped, and it is not half of a doubled quote)

HTML.reached: the danger is in the text, contiguous and intact (an escaped text has '<' and no '<>&')

Path.reached: the sink takes a base and the text; Clean(Join(base, text)) is outside the base

sanitizer: CleanX(s) replaces every character of the set of the class X by '_' and does nothing else
tag: [a-z0-9-]+, one per case. A tag is 'seen' when 'z<tag>.' is in the lower-cased text. When the text is reached and no tag is seen, the tag is the one source of the running case; when the case has several sources, that is an error (ambiguous)

probes.why: the quote of the danger follows a backslash
the quote of the danger follows a quote
the quote of the danger is followed by a quote (doubled)

probe_notes: {D} is the danger of the class in the variant that runs; {DQ} is the danger with its first character doubled. A probe passes when the judgement of the class gives 'reached' as written.
observed: observed.json is {"<case id>": [{"file":"cells/..","line":N,"class":"Cmd|SQL|HTML|Path|Any","seen":[tag],"reached":[tag],"carry":[tag]}]}, hits in the order of the calls; the file is relative to the root of the zoo of the language. A case of the language is run three times (variant 0, variant 1, variant 0 in reverse order); the run of variant 0 is the observation, variant 1 gives the carry, and the reverse run must see the same.
